title: Use of Somatropin in Turner Syndrome
brief_summary: This trial is conducted in Europe. The aim of this trial is to study the dose-response relationship and effect of somatropin (Norditropin®) on final height in girls with Turner Syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Turner Syndrome
* Not previously treated with growth hormone or androgen
* Well-documented height over the previous 12 months
* Informed consent of parents (and child if appropriate)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Growth hormone (GH) deficiency based on a GH stimulation test
